mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_search_history ( user_id, query_text, query_text_normalized, search_count, last_search_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{queryText}, #{normalizedQuery}, 1, NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE query_text = VALUES(query_text), search_count = search_count + 1, last_search_time = NOW(), deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, query_text, query_text_normalized, search_count, last_search_time, deleted FROM user_search_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY last_search_time DESC, search_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_search_history SET deleted = 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
